title: Celtic transfer rumours: Duran, Nygren and Ebonog stir the pot
body:
Celtic are back in the gossip columns, with BBC Sport reporting that interest is building around Duran and Nygren [S1]. The story is filed under gossip, and that label tells you most of what you need to know about its weight right now [S1].

The detail is more specific. A Premier League club is reportedly keeping an eye on a Celtic summer signing, while Serie A sides are monitoring the champions' Swedish midfielder [S1]. BBC Sport also ran a separate story saying Celtic have their eye on midfielder Ebonog [S2]. That piece describes two possible January targets and says a Turkish club still maintains interest in a Rangers midfielder [S2].

There are no form numbers or predictions in the evidence to lean on, so the honest read is that these are names on a list, not players in the building. Every one of these links is a suitor, not a signing, and suitors come and go.

Still, a club whose players and targets draw attention from several leagues is in a healthy spot. If any of these moves lands, it will say plenty about the direction the side believes it is heading. The trouble is that a lot of this talk never reaches a contract.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: Celtic duo Duran and Nygren attract interest - gossip. Premier League club keep an eye on Celtic summer signing as Serie A sides monitor the champion's Swedish midfielder...
BBC Sport: Celtic have eye on midfielder Ebonog - gossip. Two possible January targets for Celtic as Turkish club maintain interest in Rangers midfielder...
